collateral_ratio_scale_basis: every collateral_ratio in this file is a PERCENT: 151.35 means 151.35%. Normalised on write from the snapshot's percent so the shared backing_history.json column means one thing across assets; collateral_ratio_source_scale on each row names what it was converted from. Do not infer scale from the field name.
history_coverage: Coverage history starts 2026-10-11T16:43:47Z, the first issuer snapshot this producer stored. No backfill: no preserved prior frxUSD balance-sheet snapshots exist, and none were reconstructed. Timestamps are the issuer's effective time, one row per distinct snapshot. The export holds the trailing 7 days only.
collateral_ratio_basis: Issuer-reported global coverage: Frax totalAssets / totalLiabilities x 100 from /v2/frxusd/balance-sheet/latest. Not an Ethereum-only ratio and not a custodian attestation.
